condition: Casting a datetime Series to str with astype(str) uses value-dependent formatting, so it drops fractional seconds when every value is a whole second, instead of formatting based on the dtype's unit.
workaround: Use s.dt.strftime with an explicit format (e.g. "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f", then .str.slice(stop=-3) for milliseconds) to get the same output for every value.
